episodes.synopsis: Did someone say goblins? Peter just received orders to hold back a horde of female goblins invading the countryside.
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Goblin Apocalypse

episodes.synopsis: While Peter weeps in his cell, an Elite Hobgoblin named Gobuko unexpectedly comes to his rescue. It’s almost as though she’s got something on her mind…
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Goblin Who Returned the Favor

episodes.synopsis: When humans successfully route the horde, is extermination the only solution? This looks like a job for a completely different kind of goblin slayer!
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Only Neat Thing to Do

episodes.synopsis: Lucy Grill certainly has a lot of guts. Why, she’ll just go berserk if she ever finds out her brother cheated on Luvellia!
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the World’s Strongest Little Sister

episodes.synopsis: Peter’s already complicated life grows more so when Lucy joins the Warriors Guild. He needs to be extra careful now!
episodes.title: Peter Grill and Family Ties

episodes.synopsis: Peter needs a break after everything he’s gone through. Unfortunately for him, certain someones have other plans.
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Enjoyment of the Spa Resort

episodes.synopsis: After being abducted from the spa resort, Peter awakens and stands before Vegan’s sister! Three guesses what she wants.
episodes.title: Peter Grill and a Family Disgraced

episodes.synopsis: Vegan won’t just stand around and let her sister take Peter away!
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Sisterly Feud

episodes.synopsis: Vegan and Fulltalia's sibling rivalry is getting out of hand!
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Essence of an Apology

episodes.synopsis: The Guildmaster vows to acknowledge Peter if he reaffirms the Guild’s alliance with the Dwarves? Peter smells a trap...
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Dwarven Alliance

episodes.synopsis: Peter and Misslim get locked in a room together, and the only way they can escape is by performing a suspiciously specific action…
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Inescapable Room

episodes.synopsis: The Guildmaster’s plan pays off! Fortunately for Peter (but unfortunately for everyone else), the Dwarves’ natural predator chooses this moment to attack the ceremony.
episodes.title: Peter Grill and the Future Legacy
